cohortDescription: Individuals with a non-missing bone-metastasis date falling within -90 to +30 days of the metastasis date. Cohort start is the bone-metastasis date; cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.
Individuals with a zoledronic acid (ZA) and/or denosumab start. Cohort start is the earlier of the two BPA start dates (ties assigned to ZA); cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.

Individuals with no ZA and no denosumab start, who received at least one of ADT, ARPI, or chemotherapy. Cohort start is the earliest of the ADT/ARPI/chemo start dates (same-day ties resolved ADT > ARPI > chemo); cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.

include individuals from 90100 with NO BPA (cohort 1822) treatment initiation later then 30 days before bone metastasis date. Index is the date of Systemic treatment initiation  (ADT OR ARPI OR Chemo). It’s a sensitivity cohort
Individuals in the BPA population whose first bone-targeting agent is denosumab. Cohort start is the denosumab start date; cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.
Individuals in the BPA population whose first bone-targeting agent is ZA. Cohort start is the ZA start date; cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.
Individuals in the BPA population whose first bone-targeting agent is AA. Cohort start is the AA start date; cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record. It’s a sensitivity cohort

Denosumab individuals with ADT started within -30 to +180 days of the metastasis date, and no ARPI or chemotherapy within that window. Cohort start is the denosumab start date; cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.

Denosumab individuals with both ADT and ARPI started within -30 to +180 days of the metastasis date, and no chemotherapy within that window. Cohort start is the denosumab start date; cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.

Denosumab individuals with both ADT and chemotherapy started within -30 to +180 days of the metastasis date, and no ARPI within that window. Cohort start is the denosumab start date; cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.

Denosumab individuals with ADT, ARPI, and chemotherapy all started within -30 to +180 days of the metastasis date. Cohort start is the denosumab start date; cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.

ZA individuals with ADT started within -30 to +180 days of the metastasis date, and no ARPI or chemotherapy within that window. Cohort start is the ZA start date; cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.

ZA individuals with both ADT and ARPI started within -30 to +180 days of the metastasis date, and no chemotherapy within that window. Cohort start is the ZA start date; cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.

ZA individuals with both ADT and chemotherapy started within -30 to +180 days of the metastasis date, and no ARPI within that window. Cohort start is the ZA start date; cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.
ZA individuals with ADT, ARPI, and chemotherapy all started within -30 to +180 days of the metastasis date. Cohort start is the ZA start date; cohort end is taken from the metastasis cohort record.
